hacks.name: Pokémon Radical Red
hacks.author: soupercell (with koala4)
hacks.descriptionEn: A higher-difficulty FireRed remake built on the Complete FireRed Upgrade engine, with Pokémon up to Gen 9, modern mechanics and Mega Evolution.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein FireRed-Remake mit erhöhtem Schwierigkeitsgrad auf Basis der Complete FireRed Upgrade Engine, mit Pokémon bis Gen 9, modernen Mechaniken und Mega-Entwicklungen.
hacks.uprNote: CFRU/DPE-expanded ROM (new species tables, engine); UPR ZX cannot randomize it.
hacks.notes: Thread title states version 4.1 (first post last edited 2024-03-22). Patch must be applied to FireRed USA 1.0 (not Rev 1).

hacks.name: Pokémon Unbound
hacks.author: Skeli
hacks.descriptionEn: A complete FireRed-based adventure in the new Borrius region with a new story, modern mechanics and several difficulty settings.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein vollständiges Abenteuer auf FireRed-Basis in der neuen Region Borrius mit eigener Story, modernen Mechaniken und mehreren Schwierigkeitsstufen.
hacks.uprNote: CFRU/DPE-expanded ROM; UPR ZX cannot randomize it.
hacks.notes: Version 2.1.1.1 is the newest listed in the first post (last edited 2025-04-14).

hacks.name: Pokémon Gaia
hacks.author: Spherical Ice
hacks.descriptionEn: A FireRed hack set in the new region of Orbtus with Pokémon up to Generation 6 and a new storyline.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein FireRed-Hack in der neuen Region Orbtus mit Pokémon bis Generation 6 und neuer Geschichte.
hacks.uprNote: Expanded species/data tables; not supported by UPR ZX.
hacks.notes: Patch file named pokemon_gaia_v3.2.ups in the official instructions (FireRed USA).

hacks.name: Pokémon Emerald Kaizo
hacks.author: SinisterHoodedFigure
hacks.descriptionEn: An extremely hard version of Emerald inspired by FireRed Omega and Pokémon Stadium, with all 386 Pokémon obtainable and extra post-game events.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine extrem schwere Fassung von Smaragd, inspiriert von FireRed Omega und Pokémon Stadium, mit allen 386 Pokémon und zusätzlichen Postgame-Events.
hacks.uprNote: Binary hack on vanilla Emerald data structures; UPR may load it but hacks are unsupported and untested here.
hacks.notes: romhacking.net link taken from the official thread; not re-verified (Cloudflare challenge).

hacks.name: Pokémon Inclement Emerald
hacks.author: Buffel Saft
hacks.descriptionEn: A decomp-based Emerald difficulty hack with Gen 4–7 moves, abilities and mechanics, level caps and smarter trainers.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Smaragd-Schwierigkeits-Hack auf Decomp-Basis mit Attacken, Fähigkeiten und Mechaniken aus Gen 4–7, Level-Caps und stärkeren Trainern.
hacks.uprNote: Built from pokeemerald with battle-engine upgrade; data layout differs from vanilla, not UPR-compatible.
hacks.notes: GitHub release v1.13 (2021-11-28) ships as a zip; patch format inside not inspected.

hacks.name: Pokémon Emerald Rogue
hacks.author: Pokabbie
hacks.descriptionEn: A roguelite reimagining of Emerald where routes, encounters, items and gym leaders are procedurally chosen on each run.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine Roguelite-Neuinterpretation von Smaragd, bei der Routen, Begegnungen, Items und Arenaleiter in jedem Run prozedural gewählt werden.
hacks.uprNote: Decomp-based with heavily changed game flow; randomization is built into the hack itself.
hacks.notes: GitHub releases 'Vanilla v2.1' and 'EX v2.1' published 2026-05-17; the forum post header still says V2.0.1.

hacks.name: Pokémon Run & Bun
hacks.author: dekzeh
hacks.descriptionEn: A difficult Emerald hack with a revamped Hoenn route, level caps tied to boss fights and modern mechanics, popular for Nuzlocke runs.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein schwerer Smaragd-Hack mit überarbeitetem Weg durch Hoenn, an Bosskämpfe gekoppelten Level-Caps und modernen Mechaniken, beliebt für Nuzlockes.
hacks.uprNote: Decomp/expansion-based ROM; not UPR-compatible.
hacks.notes: Thread title says v1.07 (body references 1.06 download). Patch applied to Emerald (U).

hacks.name: Pokémon Elite Redux
hacks.author: darkyy92 (Elite Redux team)
hacks.descriptionEn: A hard Emerald hack based on Inclement Emerald where Pokémon have multiple unique abilities, with selectable difficulty modes and level caps.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein schwerer Smaragd-Hack auf Basis von Inclement Emerald, in dem Pokémon mehrere eigene Fähigkeiten haben, mit wählbaren Schwierigkeitsgraden und Level-Caps.
hacks.uprNote: Decomp-based with expanded data; not UPR-compatible.

hacks.name: Pokémon Emerald Imperium
hacks.author: iriv24
hacks.descriptionEn: A difficulty-focused Emerald hack with built-in level caps and an option to set Pokémon directly to the cap.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein auf Schwierigkeit ausgelegter Smaragd-Hack mit eingebauten Level-Caps und der Option, Pokémon direkt auf das Cap zu setzen.
hacks.uprNote: Decomp/expansion-based ROM; not UPR-compatible.
hacks.notes: Thread announces version 1.0 (posted 2025-01-24, edited 2025-04-11); later updates may exist.

hacks.name: Pokémon Scorched Silver
hacks.author: Sloo
hacks.descriptionEn: A Johto adventure built on Emerald with the pokeemerald expansion, featuring a new story around Team Phoenix and Celebi.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Johto-Abenteuer auf Smaragd-Basis mit der pokeemerald-Expansion und einer neuen Geschichte um Team Phoenix und Celebi.
hacks.uprNote: pokeemerald-expansion ROM; not UPR-compatible.

hacks.name: Pokémon Modern Emerald
hacks.author: resetes12
hacks.descriptionEn: An open-source, near-vanilla Emerald enhancement with optional modern mechanics, quality-of-life features and simple difficulty modes.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine quelloffene, nah am Original bleibende Smaragd-Erweiterung mit optionalen modernen Mechaniken, Komfortfunktionen und einfachen Schwierigkeitsmodi.
hacks.uprNote: Decomp-based; not UPR-compatible.

hacks.name: Pokémon Emerald Seaglass
hacks.author: Nemo622
hacks.descriptionEn: An Emerald hack with a cozy Game Boy Color-style visual overhaul and all Gen 1–3 Pokémon obtainable.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Smaragd-Hack mit gemütlicher Grafik im Game-Boy-Color-Stil, in dem alle Pokémon der Gen 1–3 erhältlich sind.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.
hacks.notes: Author's Ko-fi page hosts the patch; release (Aug 2024) details from the author's announcement, version number not verified.

hacks.name: Pokémon Light Platinum
hacks.author: Wesley FG
hacks.descriptionEn: A classic Ruby-based hack set in the new Zhery region with a new story and Pokémon from Gens 1–4.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein klassischer Hack auf Rubin-Basis in der neuen Region Zhery mit neuer Geschichte und Pokémon aus Gen 1–4.
hacks.uprNote: Binary hack; not tested with UPR.
hacks.notes: Thread offers patches for Ruby (U) v1.0 (F0815EE7) and v1.1 (61641576).

hacks.name: Pokémon Polished Crystal
hacks.author: Rangi
hacks.descriptionEn: An extensive enhancement of Crystal built from the pret disassembly, with expanded content, updated mechanics and an optional 'faithful' variant.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine umfangreiche Erweiterung von Kristall auf Basis der pret-Disassembly mit mehr Inhalten, aktualisierten Mechaniken und optionaler 'faithful'-Variante.
hacks.uprNote: Rebuilt from source with different data layout; UPR ZX only supports vanilla Crystal (and Speedchoice).
hacks.notes: v3.2.3 (GitHub, 2025-12-12) ships prebuilt .gbc files plus 3DS VC .patch files, no IPS/BPS; older releases had IPS patches for Crystal (UE) 1.0.

hacks.name: Pokémon Crystal Clear
hacks.author: ShockSlayer
hacks.descriptionEn: An open-world Crystal hack where you choose your starter and starting town, and gym battles scale with your badge count.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Open-World-Hack von Kristall, in dem Starter und Startstadt frei wählbar sind und Arenakämpfe mit der Orden-Zahl skalieren.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.
hacks.notes: Official page states the .bps patch is distributed only via the Crystal Clear Discord; current version not verifiable from public pages.

hacks.name: Pokémon Prism
hacks.author: RainbowDevs (Koolboyman)
hacks.descriptionEn: A heavily customized Crystal mod set in the new Naljo region with new mechanics; development continues as patches on the RainbowDevs site.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine stark angepasste Kristall-Modifikation in der neuen Region Naljo mit neuen Mechaniken; die Entwicklung läuft als Patches über die RainbowDevs-Seite weiter.
hacks.uprNote: Heavily rebuilt Crystal mod; not UPR-compatible.
hacks.notes: Status: maintained by RainbowDevs; latest listed 0.95.0254 (released 2023-08-24). Patched via the site's in-browser patcher (format not stated, believed to be BSP). The PokéCommunity 'Final Version' thread is an April Fools post.

hacks.name: Pokémon Crystal Legacy
hacks.author: cRz Shadows
hacks.descriptionEn: A Crystal enhancement that keeps the original feel while fixing balance issues and adding quality-of-life features and an optional hardcore mode.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine Kristall-Erweiterung, die das Originalgefühl bewahrt, Balance-Probleme behebt und Komfortfunktionen sowie einen optionalen Hardcore-Modus ergänzt.
hacks.uprNote: pret-based build with shifted data; UPR uses fixed offsets for Gen 2, so expect issues.
hacks.notes: Release 1.3.1 (2024-08-30); 1.3.0 assets named 'IPS Patches'.

hacks.name: Pokémon Yellow Legacy
hacks.author: cRz Shadows
hacks.descriptionEn: A Yellow enhancement that fixes Gen 1 balance problems and adds quality-of-life features while keeping the original feel.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine Gelb-Erweiterung, die Balance-Probleme der Gen 1 behebt und Komfortfunktionen ergänzt, ohne das Originalgefühl zu verlieren.
hacks.uprNote: pret-based build; UPR expects vanilla Yellow, expect issues.
hacks.notes: Release notes give base Yellow SHA-1 cc7d0326…, which matches No-Intro Yellow (USA, Europe) CRC 7D527D62.

hacks.name: Shin Pokémon Red/Blue
hacks.author: jojobear13
hacks.descriptionEn: A community enhancement patch for Red and Blue based on the pret disassembly, fixing bugs and adding optional features while staying close to the original.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Community-Verbesserungspatch für Rot und Blau auf Basis der pret-Disassembly, der Fehler behebt und optionale Funktionen ergänzt, ohne vom Original abzuweichen.
hacks.uprNote: pret-based build; not tested with UPR.
hacks.notes: Red patches target USA Red (CRC 9F7FDD53); Blue/Green patches target USA Blue (CRC D6DA8A1A).

hacks.name: Pokémon Blue Kaizo
hacks.author: SinisterHoodedFigure
hacks.descriptionEn: An extremely hard edit of Pokémon Blue with tougher trainers inspired by Pokémon Stadium.
hacks.descriptionDe: Eine extrem schwere Bearbeitung von Pokémon Blau mit stärkeren Trainern nach Vorbild von Pokémon Stadium.
hacks.uprNote: Binary hack on vanilla data; not tested.

hacks.name: Pokémon Crystal Kaizo
hacks.author: SinisterHoodedFigure
hacks.descriptionEn: The official sequel to Blue Kaizo: a very hard edit of Crystal with significantly stronger trainers.
hacks.descriptionDe: Der offizielle Nachfolger von Blue Kaizo: eine sehr schwere Bearbeitung von Kristall mit deutlich stärkeren Trainern.
hacks.uprNote: Binary hack on vanilla data; not tested.

hacks.name: Pokémon Renegade Platinum
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: An enhancement hack of Platinum with tougher trainers, wider Pokémon availability and Fairy type, in the style of Drayano's other hacks.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Erweiterungs-Hack von Platin mit stärkeren Trainern, mehr verfügbaren Pokémon und Feen-Typ im Stil von Drayanos anderen Hacks.
hacks.uprNote: Uses vanilla Gen 4 file formats but edited scripts; UPR is not officially supported for hacks.
hacks.notes: Latest Version v1.3.0 (2019-04-16) per Drayano's Project Pokémon post. Applies to Platinum USA; exact revision not verified.

hacks.name: Pokémon Sacred Gold
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: An enhancement hack of HeartGold with harder trainers, all 493 Pokémon obtainable and trade evolutions replaced by items.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Erweiterungs-Hack von HeartGold mit stärkeren Trainern, allen 493 Pokémon und durch Items ersetzten Tauschentwicklungen.
hacks.uprNote: Vanilla Gen 4 formats with edited scripts; not tested.
hacks.notes: Drayano's GBAtemp thread lists 'Current Version 1.05' with Complete and Classic patches; requires a clean HeartGold ROM.

hacks.name: Pokémon Storm Silver
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: The SoulSilver counterpart of Sacred Gold, with harder trainers, all 493 Pokémon obtainable and trade evolutions replaced by items.
hacks.descriptionDe: Das SoulSilver-Gegenstück zu Sacred Gold mit stärkeren Trainern, allen 493 Pokémon und durch Items ersetzten Tauschentwicklungen.
hacks.uprNote: Vanilla Gen 4 formats with edited scripts; not tested.

hacks.name: Pokémon Blaze Black 2 Redux
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: Drayano's revised version of Blaze Black 2 with harder trainers, broad Pokémon availability and updated mechanics.
hacks.descriptionDe: Drayanos überarbeitete Fassung von Blaze Black 2 mit stärkeren Trainern, großer Pokémon-Auswahl und aktualisierten Mechaniken.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested; Gen 5 formats are vanilla but hack data is edited.
hacks.notes: No dedicated official Redux web page found; url is the author's X account. Version 1.4.1 seen only in community tools. The Project Pokémon link is the original (non-Redux) 1.1 release.

hacks.name: Pokémon Volt White 2 Redux
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: The White 2 counterpart of Blaze Black 2 Redux, with harder trainers, broad Pokémon availability and updated mechanics.
hacks.descriptionDe: Das Weiß-2-Gegenstück zu Blaze Black 2 Redux mit stärkeren Trainern, großer Pokémon-Auswahl und aktualisierten Mechaniken.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.
hacks.notes: See Blaze Black 2 Redux.

hacks.name: Pokémon Blaze Black
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: Drayano's enhancement of Black with harder trainers and all 649 Pokémon obtainable; a 'clean' variant keeps vanilla Pokémon data.
hacks.descriptionDe: Drayanos Erweiterung von Schwarz mit stärkeren Trainern und allen 649 Pokémon; eine 'Clean'-Variante behält die Original-Pokémon-Daten.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.
hacks.notes: Current Version 3.1 (24 Dec 2011) per the PokéCommunity thread.

hacks.name: Pokémon Volt White
hacks.author: Drayano
hacks.descriptionEn: The White counterpart of Blaze Black, with harder trainers and all 649 Pokémon obtainable.
hacks.descriptionDe: Das Weiß-Gegenstück zu Blaze Black mit stärkeren Trainern und allen 649 Pokémon.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.

hacks.name: Pokémon Black 2 Kaizo
hacks.author: sauceyaTTa
hacks.descriptionEn: An all-double-battle difficulty hack of Black 2 with about 450 available Pokémon and balance and quality-of-life changes.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein Schwierigkeits-Hack von Schwarz 2 nur mit Doppelkämpfen, rund 450 verfügbaren Pokémon sowie Balance- und Komfortänderungen.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested.
hacks.notes: Public release thread opened 2022-10-31.

hacks.name: Pokémon Definitive HeartGold
hacks.author: BigNation
hacks.descriptionEn: An enhanced HeartGold with revamped trainers, all 493 Pokémon obtainable and many quality-of-life changes, harder than vanilla but below Kaizo level.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein verbessertes HeartGold mit überarbeiteten Trainern, allen 493 Pokémon und vielen Komfortänderungen; schwerer als das Original, aber unter Kaizo-Niveau.
hacks.uprNote: Stock UPR ZX 4.6.1 crashes on this hack; souldew's randomizer bridge skips the broken static-encounter offsets and protects two intro scripts, so randomizing works.
hacks.notes: Release thread 2025-12-20, marked COMPLETE; no version number published. Base HeartGold (USA) CRC C180A0E9 confirmed by the patch ReadMe.

hacks.name: Pokémon Definitive Platinum
hacks.author: BigNation
hacks.descriptionEn: An enhanced Platinum with revamped trainers and quality-of-life changes such as reusable Repels and Gen 5 Rare Candy use, harder than vanilla but below Kaizo level.
hacks.descriptionDe: Ein verbessertes Platin mit überarbeiteten Trainern und Komfortänderungen wie wiederverwendbaren Schutz-Items und Sonderbonbons nach Gen-5-Art; schwerer als das Original, aber unter Kaizo-Niveau.
hacks.uprNote: Not tested; the HeartGold sibling breaks stock UPR, so expect similar problems.
hacks.notes: Thread says to use a Platinum Rev. 1 ROM -> No-Intro 'Pokemon - Platinum Version (USA) (Rev 1)' CRC 69D628E8 (USA assumed).
